notes: Data sourced from Financial Datasets REST API for AAPL fiscal Q2 2026 (period ending 2026-03-28).
Revenue and net income reflect the standalone Q2 quarterly values as reported.
Operating cash flow and capital expenditures are fiscal-year-to-date (Q1+Q2) per Apple's 10-Q filing convention.
Free cash flow computed as operating_cash_flow - capital_expenditures.
Net margin and free_cash_flow_margin computed against Q2 standalone revenue.
